text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
NOOOOOO WAAAAY!! Today's horoscope has me 
dead last?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
N-No... not yet! I can turn this around 
with a lucky item!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...To spend the day carrying a giant 
octopus plushie on your back."
